CHAPTER.VERS: Jehovah reigns, He is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed, He has girded Himself with strength. The world also is established, so that it cannot be shaken.
Your throne is established from of old; You are from eternity.
The streams have lifted up, O Jehovah, the streams have lifted up their sound; the streams lift up their waves.
Jehovah on high is mightier than the sound of many waters, than the mighty breakers of the sea.
Your Testimonies are very sure; holiness befits Your house, O Jehovah, to the length of days.
